decision.reasoning_trace: In evaluating the available Bluetooth speakers, I filtered out non-speaker items like cases and cables. I looked for a balance of brand reliability, sound performance (wattage/bass), and battery life. The consideration set included a mix of mid-range (JBL Flip 5, HyperGear, XENEO) and high-end options (Sony, B&O). I chose the Sony SRS-XB43 because it offers the most robust feature set for a serious listener: a powerful Extra Bass system, IP67 durability for outdoor use, and an impressive 24-hour battery life. While the B&O is more refined, the Sony represents a better value for high-performance audio in a portable format, and it avoids the potential issues found in some of the lower-priced budget brands or refurbished units.
